create_vit_model_with_timm_loader: create a Vision Transformer model using __model_loader__ with a timm model name and pretrained weights
load_pretrained_weights_into_vit: load pretrained weights from a local file or remote URL into a timm Vision Transformer model
wrap_timm_model_with_adapter: wrap a timm VisionTransformer with TimmAdapter to extract global vectors and patch feature maps
run_forward_pass_on_images: run a forward pass on image tensors through TimmAdapter to get pre-logits and reshaped patch embeddings
review_timm_adapter_forward: review the TimmAdapter forward method to understand how it extracts and reshapes patch features from the model
